They will ask your agent things it should never answer, and without the right controls, your model will comply.

latest.title: From AI Recommendation to Bounded EKS Remediation: Validating a Risk-Gated Control Plane with Fault Injection
latest.description: This article shows how to turn AI-generated remediation recommendations into controlled, auditable actions on Amazon EKS. It covers structured remediation contracts, a ten-stage decision workflow, policy-based authorization, scoped Kubernetes permissions, fault-injection validation, independent recovery checks, investigation cost limits, and clear boundaries for actions that should remain manual.
